title: 12th Grade Completion & Stream Alignment
description: Consolidate core fundamentals in PCM, PCB, Commerce, or Arts. Identify personal strengths, interest areas, and long-term career goals.

title: Discovering Courses & Future Industries
description: Explore all viable undergraduate degrees including Engineering (CSE, AI/ML), Medical, Pharmacy (B.Pharm, Pharm.D), Law, Management, Architecture, Agriculture, Design.

title: State & National Entrance Exam Selection
description: Map all applicable entrance exams across 36 Indian States/UTs (KCET, MHT-CET, WBJEE, TS EAMCET, AP EAPCET, JEE Main, NEET, CUET, CLAT).

title: Targeted Preparation & Mock Tests
description: Follow topic-wise study plans, solve previous 10 years papers, practice mock CBT tests, and optimize speed & accuracy.

title: Exam Execution & Stress Management
description: Appear for scheduled state and national entrance examinations with confidence and strategy.

title: Score Evaluation & Rank Predictor
description: Analyze board percentage and entrance exam percentile/rank against previous year official normalization metrics.

title: Eligibility Verification & Quota Analysis
description: Verify eligibility criteria, state domicile reservation categories, management quotas, and fee waivers.

title: Target College Shortlist
description: Build a tier-ranked list of top colleges based on NIRF rank, NBA accreditation, lab infrastructure, placement records, and fee structures.

title: Centralized Counselling & Seat Allocation
description: Participate in state single-window counselling (KEA, DTE, JAC, CENTAC, UPTAC) and strategically order choice filling.

title: College Admission & Academic Excellence
description: Enroll in the selected degree program and build strong fundamental domain knowledge across semesters while maintaining high CGPA.

title: Industry-Relevant Skill & Tools Acquisition
description: Master modern practical skills: Full-Stack Dev, Data Science, AWS/DevOps, QA/QC testing, CAD/FEA, Pharmacovigilance, Legal drafting, or Financial modeling.

title: Real-World Projects & Portfolio Development
description: Develop 3-5 real-world industry capstone projects. Host code on GitHub, deploy live web applications, or publish research papers.
actionables: Publish live demo URL & GitHub repo

title: Summer Internships & Industry Exposure
description: Secure 2-3 months summer internships or industrial training in reputed companies, pharma labs, tech startups, or law firms.

title: Resume, GitHub & LinkedIn Brand Building
description: Craft ATS-friendly professional resume, optimize LinkedIn profile for recruiters, and showcase project portfolio.

title: Aptitude, Coding, Technical & HR Interview Prep
description: Practice quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, data structures & algorithms (DSA), system design, and mock HR interviews.
actionables: Practice mock interviews with EduPath AI

title: Placement Drive & Securing Your First Job
description: Participate in campus placement drives and off-campus recruitment to land your dream job offer as a graduate engineer, scientist, or associate.
